name: app-brain-dwi-preproc-slim
description: Brain diffusion MRI preprocessing with reverse phase-encode distortion correction (topup), slice-to-volume motion correction (eddy_cuda), DTI fitting, and JHU ICBM-DTI-81 white-matter ROI extraction. Slim container: identical pipeline to app-brain-dwi-preproc, built with only the tools it runs.
